author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects processes reading LSASS memory or command lines that name LSASS alongside a dumping utility. LSASS holds cached credential material, so a memory dump of it is a direct precursor to lateral movement.
false_positives: Endpoint protection products and crash-reporting agents legitimately open LSASS. Baseline the accessing image path before enabling this rule in production.
name: Credential Dumping Indicators Against LSASS
note: Investigation fields: process.name, process.executable, process.command_line, process.target.name, user.name
query: ((((winlog.event_id : "10" and process.target.name : "*\\lsass.exe") and (process.access_mask : "*0x1010*" or process.access_mask : "*0x1410*" or process.access_mask : "*0x143a*")) or (process.command_line : "*lsass*" and (process.command_line : "*procdump*" or process.command_line : "*comsvcs.dll*" or process.command_line : "*MiniDump*" or process.command_line : "*rundll32*"))) and not (process.executable : "C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*" or process.executable : "C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\*"))
